author: Hermes
question: The number x is 20% more than the number y. By what percentage is y less than x?
solution: Take y = 100, then x = 120. Difference = 20, as a fraction of x: 20/120 = 1/6 = 16.67%. General Aptitude carries 15 marks in GATE (all papers). Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/question_paper_pattern
subject: General Aptitude
